notes.title: We Uploaded The Wrong Version of The Demo...Sorry!
notes.notes:
Hey Folks,

In our excitement about the CyberpunkXXX demo finally being available on Steam we accidently made the Steam demo review version downloadable. 

We have now uploaded the ACTUAL demo version. This version has fun stuff like missions and NPC dialogue etc.

Uninstall the current version. I think you may have to restart steam to get the real version.

Sorry about that...ooops!

The CyberpunkXXX Team
